avis.titre: Great Product: 3 Useful Notes for the Buyer
avis.texte: This product is my go to for puffy eyes! I highly recommend it. I have purchased it at least 6 if not 7 times. However, I have 3 notes to keep in mind. First, despite what the directions say, you need to use this on a clean face, meaning do not use it if you have applied any serum, face cream, SPF, or foundation makeup to the eye area. It's been my experience that if you use it on top of another product of any kind it will create a visible white film. The worst part about that visible film is that it may take a while to appear. For instance, I applied the product on my puffy eyes at home, and about a half hour later I left for the day. Later in the day, I was mortified when I looked in a mirror and discovered two bright white half moons under my eyes! It looked like clown makeup, or like I had some type of skin condition. Second,the firmness (anti-puffing affect) begins to diminish after about 3 hours and seems to be gone after about 5 hours. My final note, is to be aware that when it seems as if there's no more product left (meaning when you press the pump and nothing comes out, even after shaking or tapping the bottle against a hard surface) what I've discovered is that the pump on the bottle cannot access all of the product. So, believe it or not, I've been taking a hammer to the container to remove the pump and access the remaining product at the bottom with a Q-tip. If you choose to try this, be sure to save the cap so you can keep the product moist. One of the beauties

If you don't use the product for a couple of days, the product in the dispenser tube just before it comes out drys out. This makes it impossible to get any of it out. If you press to hard it comes out of the sides. I emailed customer service and they told me to tap the container, which is plastic, on the bathroon sink to dislodge the dry pieces but that doesn't work. This is really a pretty good product in a POORLY DESIGNED container. They would have been just better off putting it in a tube, like a toothpast type container, that this fancy piece of garbage.

avis.titre: The product works great but getting it out of its' contai...
avis.texte: The small bottle that contains the eye tightening product does not dispense the serum correctly most of the time. The product completely dried up in my second bottle rattling around inside and the third time I purchased the product the pump would freeze then when pushed harder an amount bigger then needed would shoot out. I'm hoping the company is reading all the reviews complaining about the difficulties with how their product is dispensed and is working to correct the problem. So as for the pump I give one star. On the other hand the product, once you get it to dispense correctly, works really well after practicing how to best put it on. I find that using a small makeup brush and patting on a small amount under my eyes with it works well. If I put on a bit too much I get tiny puckers and if I put on too little it is ineffective. I give the actual product 4 stars as most of the time it works. Not sure if I will order again however due to the problems with the dispensing.
